item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We can end work as a condition of survival and give everyone the freedom to create, care, learn, rest, and thrive.

2. We reject a future where superintelligent AI enriches a handful of owners while everyone else struggles. If it is built within 20 years, no human will ever need to work again—and its abundance must belong to everyone.

3. Superintelligent AI will make compulsory work obsolete. If we build it within the next 20 years, no human will ever need a job to survive again. We must ensure that freedom, security, and abundance are guaranteed to all.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 105 words

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We are preparing for a future in which intelligence, production, and essential services can operate without human labor. That transformation will end work as a condition of survival, freeing every person to spend their time on family, community, creativity, learning, care, and rest. Our task is to ensure the abundance created by superintelligence belongs to everyone, not only to those who own the technology. We will fight for universal access to its benefits, democratic control over its deployment, and a social contract that guarantees dignity, security, and freedom for all.
